purpose: Verify that an authorized user can access the course workspace and view syllabus, schedule, instructors, and TAs.
preconditions: Course exists; user is enrolled in, assigned to, or linked to the course according to available registration data.
action_or_input: Authorized user selects the course from Fusion.
expected_result: Dedicated course workspace opens displaying syllabus, schedule, instructor(s), and TA(s).

purpose: Verify that course workspace access is denied when the user is not authorized for the selected course.
preconditions: Course exists; user is not enrolled in, assigned to, or linked to the course.
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to open the course workspace.
expected_result: Access is denied; no course workspace or content is exposed.

purpose: Verify that workspace access is blocked when authoritative registration/link data are unavailable.
preconditions: Course exists; authoritative course-registration or link data source is unavailable.
action_or_input: User attempts to access the course workspace.
expected_result: System cannot confirm access, denies entry, and does not expose the workspace.

purpose: Verify that assigned Faculty can configure, save, and publish course workspace details.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course.
action_or_input: Assigned Faculty opens course-management controls, edits course workspace details, and saves/publishes changes.
expected_result: System stores and presents updated course details in the course workspace.

purpose: Verify that assigned Faculty can edit previously published course details.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course; course details have previously been published.
action_or_input: Assigned Faculty modifies existing course details and saves changes.
expected_result: System stores updated details and displays the revised course details.

purpose: Verify that course details management attempts by unauthorized Faculty are rejected.
preconditions: Faculty user is not assigned to the course.
action_or_input: Unassigned Faculty attempts to open course-management controls and update details.
expected_result: Update attempt is rejected; existing course details remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify that assigned Faculty can add course material to a module/section with immediate publication.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course.
action_or_input: Faculty adds a file, link, or note, assigns it to a module or weekly section, selects immediate publication, and saves.
expected_result: System validates and saves the material configuration; material status is marked Published.

purpose: Verify that assigned Faculty can edit or reorganize existing course materials.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course; course materials already exist in the course.
action_or_input: Faculty edits content or reorganizes existing material into a different module or weekly section and saves.
expected_result: System updates and commits the reorganized material configuration.

purpose: Verify that material write attempts by TA, Observer, or Student are rejected.
preconditions: User is a TA, Observer, or Student in the course.
action_or_input: Non-Faculty user attempts to upload, edit, or reorganize course materials.
expected_result: Write attempt is rejected; no unauthorized material changes are committed.

purpose: Verify that authorized course users (Student, TA, Observer) can view published course materials in read-only form.
preconditions: User has course access; material is published.
action_or_input: Authorized user opens the Materials area and opens a published material item.
expected_result: System lists published materials and displays the selected item in read-only form.

purpose: Verify that scheduled or unpublished material is omitted from view until released.
preconditions: User has course access; material is unpublished or scheduled for future release.
action_or_input: User accesses the Materials area prior to material release date/time.
expected_result: Scheduled/unpublished material is omitted from the display and remains unexposed.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized course access is denied when attempting to view course materials.
preconditions: User is not enrolled, assigned, or linked to the course.
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to view the course Materials area.
expected_result: Access is denied; no materials are exposed.

purpose: Verify that assigned Faculty can create and post a timestamped course-wide announcement.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course.
action_or_input: Faculty enters announcement content and submits.
expected_result: System verifies posting authority, timestamps and stores announcement, and makes it visible course-wide.

purpose: Verify that a Teaching Assistant permitted by Faculty can post a course-wide announcement.
preconditions: TA is assigned to the course and has announcement permission granted by Faculty.
action_or_input: Permitted TA submits announcement content.
expected_result: System verifies TA posting authority, timestamps and stores announcement, and makes it visible course-wide.

purpose: Verify that announcement posting attempts by unauthorized users or non-permitted TAs are rejected.
preconditions: User is a TA without announcement posting permission, a Student, an Observer, or unassigned user.
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to post an announcement.
expected_result: Posting attempt is rejected; no unauthorized announcement is posted.

purpose: Verify that authorized course users can view course-wide announcements with timestamps.
preconditions: User has authorized course access; course announcements exist.
action_or_input: Authorized user opens the Announcements area.
expected_result: System retrieves and displays course announcements with their respective timestamps.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized course access is denied when attempting to view course announcements.
preconditions: User has no authorized access to the course.
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to access the Announcements area.
expected_result: Access is denied; unauthorized announcements are not exposed.

purpose: Verify that assigned Faculty can create a valid assignment and store it in Draft state.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course.
action_or_input: Faculty enters due date, instructions, submission type, and points possible, then saves the assignment.
expected_result: System validates required data and saves the assignment in Draft state.

purpose: Verify that assigned Faculty can edit an existing Draft assignment.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course; assignment exists in Draft state.
action_or_input: Faculty updates configuration fields of the Draft assignment and saves changes.
expected_result: System validates and stores updated configuration, maintaining the assignment in Draft state.

purpose: Verify that assignment-authoring attempts by TA, Student, or Observer are rejected.
preconditions: User has TA, Student, or Observer role in the course.
action_or_input: Non-Faculty user attempts to create or edit an assignment.
expected_result: Authoring attempt is rejected; invalid/unauthorized changes are not committed.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can publish a valid Draft assignment for immediate availability to students.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to course; assignment is in Draft state with valid configuration; release timing is immediate.
action_or_input: Faculty confirms publication of the Draft assignment.
expected_result: System marks assignment Published and makes it Available to students.

purpose: Verify that publishing a Draft assignment with a future release date sets status to Scheduled for Release.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to course; assignment is in Draft state with a future-dated release time.
action_or_input: Faculty confirms publication of the future-dated Draft assignment.
expected_result: System marks assignment Published and Scheduled for Release, waiting for scheduled release event (UC-LMS-015).

purpose: Verify that publishing an invalid Draft assignment lacking required configuration is rejected.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to course; Draft assignment lacks required configuration parameters.
action_or_input: Faculty attempts to publish the invalid Draft assignment.
expected_result: Publishing fails validation; assignment remains in Draft state.

purpose: Verify that a registered Student can view assignment details and download content for a released assignment.
preconditions: Student is registered in the course; assignment is Published and release condition is satisfied.
action_or_input: Student opens Assignments area and selects the released assignment.
expected_result: System displays assignment details and permits download of published assignment content.

purpose: Verify that future-dated unreleased assignments are omitted from student view.
preconditions: Student is registered in the course; assignment is Published but Scheduled for Release in the future.
action_or_input: Student accesses the Assignments area prior to assignment release time.
expected_result: Future-dated unreleased assignment is not displayed to the Student.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized course users are denied access to view or download published assignments.
preconditions: User is not registered in or authorized for the course.
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to access the Assignments area.
expected_result: Access is denied; no assignment details or downloads are exposed.

purpose: Verify that a registered Student can submit assignment work matching configured type on-time before due date.
preconditions: Student is registered; assignment is Available; submission is attempted before due date; submission type is configured.
action_or_input: Student provides work (file, text, or link as configured) and confirms submission.
expected_result: System validates submission type and timing, records the submission, and sets submission timestamp and status.

purpose: Verify that an assignment submission with a type inconsistent with assignment configuration is rejected.
preconditions: Student is registered; assignment is Available; assignment requires a specific submission type.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit work using a type inconsistent with configuration (e.g. submitting text for a file-only assignment).
expected_result: Submission is rejected by system validation; no invalid submission is recorded.

purpose: Verify that a registered Student can view their own submission history and status.
preconditions: Student is registered in the course; Student has submitted work for the assignment.
action_or_input: Student opens submission details/history for the assignment.
expected_result: System retrieves only that Student's submissions and displays submission history and status.

purpose: Verify that submission status reflects applicable status (such as missing or late) when viewing submission details.
preconditions: Student is registered in the course; assignment exists and due date has passed without on-time submission.
action_or_input: Student views submission status for the assignment.
expected_result: System displays applicable submission status as missing or late.

purpose: Verify that access to another Student's submission data is denied.
preconditions: Student A and Student B are enrolled in the course; Student B has a submission on record.
action_or_input: Student A attempts to view or query Student B's submission history and status.
expected_result: Access is denied; no other Student's submission data are exposed.

purpose: Verify that Faculty or assigned TA can grade a submission and store points/feedback in Draft state with actor attribution.
preconditions: Actor is Faculty or TA assigned to the course; student submission exists.
action_or_input: Grader opens the student submission, enters points and feedback, and saves.
expected_result: System records grading action and actor identity; grade/feedback is stored in Draft state.

purpose: Verify that modifying an already released grade creates an audit record capturing actor and timestamp.
preconditions: Actor is Faculty assigned to the course; grade for submission has already been released.
action_or_input: Faculty modifies points or feedback for the released grade and saves.
expected_result: System updates the grade and generates an audit record documenting the actor identity and timestamp of the change.

purpose: Verify that grading attempts by unauthorized grader/course combinations are rejected.
preconditions: User is not assigned as Faculty or TA for the course; student submission exists.
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to enter points or feedback for the submission.
expected_result: Grading attempt is rejected; no unauthorized grade change is committed.

purpose: Verify that assigned Faculty can release draft grades/feedback to students.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course; draft grades/feedback exist for the course.
action_or_input: Faculty selects and initiates release of draft grades.
expected_result: System verifies Faculty release authority, transitions grades from Draft to Released, and makes them available to corresponding students.

purpose: Verify that a Teaching Assistant (TA) cannot perform grade release.
preconditions: User is a TA assigned to the course; draft grades exist.
action_or_input: TA attempts to initiate grade release.
expected_result: Grade release action is rejected; draft grades remain hidden.

purpose: Verify that a Student can view their own released grade and feedback in read-only form.
preconditions: Student is registered in the course; grade/feedback has been released for the Student.
action_or_input: Student opens Grades for the assignment/course.
expected_result: System displays the Student's own released grade and feedback in read-only form.

purpose: Verify that draft/unreleased grades and feedback are not shown to the Student.
preconditions: Student is registered in the course; grade/feedback for Student's submission exists in Draft state.
action_or_input: Student opens Grades for the assignment/course.
expected_result: Draft/unreleased grade and feedback are not displayed to the Student.

purpose: Verify that access to another Student's grade or feedback is denied.
preconditions: Student A and Student B are enrolled in the course; grade/feedback has been released for Student B.
action_or_input: Student A attempts to access or view Student B's grade and feedback.
expected_result: Access is denied; Student B's grade data is not exposed.

purpose: Verify that scheduled content becomes Published/Available and visible when its configured release time is reached.
preconditions: Content is in Scheduled state and remains valid for publication; release date/time is reached.
action_or_input: Event trigger executes scheduled content release processing at the configured release time.
expected_result: Content state transitions to Published/Available and becomes visible to the authorized audience.

purpose: Verify that no release occurs if scheduled content was withdrawn or unpublished before the release time.
preconditions: Scheduled content was withdrawn or unpublished prior to its configured release time.
action_or_input: Configured release date/time is reached and release processing runs.
expected_result: Content is identified as ineligible; no release occurs and content remains unexposed.

purpose: Verify that if release processing fails, content remains unavailable and the failure is recorded for operational handling.
preconditions: Content is in Scheduled state; release processing encounters an operational failure.
action_or_input: Release processing execution encounters a failure condition at release time.
expected_result: Content is not exposed prematurely, remains unavailable, and the failure is recorded for operational handling.
